idea: Themed weeks, Economy day: written from the source, then corrected by two independent editors before voicing.
description: Crops made 31.1% of Madhya Pradesh's output (gross state value added, current prices) in 2023-24, the highest of 33 states and Union territories with a figure. Tripura was next at 24.0%; Uttar Pradesh's share was 16.4%, so Madhya Pradesh's was 1.9 times that.

It was also the highest in 2021-22 (32.6%) and 2022-23 (31.1%). In Madhya Pradesh crops added 4.2 times what manufacturing added. Output is booked in the state; it is not what residents earn. Gujarat has no 2023-24 figure. Recent years can be revised.
source: National Statistics Office, Ministry of Statistics and Programme Implementation, as published in the RBI Handbook of Statistics on Indian States 2024-25: gross state value added by economic activity at current prices (base 2011-12), Table 29, agriculture (the table's note: the data pertain to crops), over the state total, Table 25; manufacturing is Table 33. 33 states and UTs have a 2023-24 figure; Gujarat has none. Recent years can be revised. Booked in the state, not what residents earn.
